author: eliza
source: his 2026-11-10 09:42 "let's do one quick probe just incase it works first time" (plan OT-32, place.resource): a board site only on a planet with tungsten
_note: RESOURCE PROBE RS1 (plan OT-32): one use at a quiet site, silent, placeholder words. Not a mission.

No vanilla request carries BodyHasResource (census 2026-11-10), so this asks whether one can. Three readings: (1) it LISTS and the site's planet shows Tungsten (W) in its scanner resources: it works; (2) it lists on a planet WITHOUT tungsten: the condition is ignored; (3) it never lists after a few refreshes: the request cannot pass it (or no planet in reach has W).
Any fault is the resource test, not the place: b1's quiet site and object. Unbuilt once read.
